## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A single-fascicle Yogācāra commentary by [德清](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%BE%B7%E6%B8%85) Hānshān Déqīng (1546–1623) on Vasubandhu's [KR6n0096](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6n/KR6n0096) *Dàshèng bǎifǎ míngmén lùn* 大乘百法明門論 (T31n1614, in [玄奘](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%8E%84%E5%A5%98)'s translation). One of Hānshān's central late-Míng Yogācāra works and one of the earliest sustained re-engagements with the *Bǎifǎ míngmén lùn* in the late-Míng Cí'ēn revival. Preserved in the *Manji Xuzangjing* 卍續藏 at X48n0802.

**Abstract**

Within the late-Míng Yogācāra revival the *Lùnyì* is one of the principal "Chán reading" of the *Bǎifǎ míngmén lùn* — that is, a commentary that deliberately treats the Yogācāra catalog of dharmas not as a doctrinal end in itself but as an expository instrument for opening up the *yīxīn* doctrine of the *Qǐxìn lùn*. This positions Hānshān's reading squarely against the more strictly Cí'ēn-philological commentaries of his contemporary [明昱](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%98%8E%E6%98%B1) (e.g. [KR6n0105](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6n/KR6n0105)) and student [廣益](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%BB%A3%E7%9B%8A) ([KR6n0104](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6n/KR6n0104)), and it is the platform from which his own disciple [智旭](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%99%BA%E6%97%AD) (1599–1655) developed the further integrative reading of [KR6n0106](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6n/KR6n0106) *Bǎifǎ míngmén lùn zhíjiě* 百法明門論直解.

The dating window adopted (1597–1623) brackets Hānshān's productive late period after his exile to Léizhōu through to his death; the work belongs to the same Wàn-lì-era project of re-establishing Yogācāra study that produced the *Xìngxiàng tōngshuō* preface and the *Bā shí guījǔ tōngshuō* ([KR6n0135](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6n/KR6n0135)).
